name: Courtney McNamara
researchKeywords: international trade and health, social determinants of health, labour markets, public health policy
bio: Courtney McNamara is a Lecturer in Public Health whose work addresses public health policy problems and the social determinants of health inequalities.
researchFocus: Courtney studies the health effects of international trade and the relationships between COVID-19, labour markets and health. She leads a Norwegian Research Council-funded project examining whether trade shocks harm health and which policies could prevent those harms.

professionalRoles.title: Affiliated researcher
professionalRoles.organisation: Centre for Global Health Inequalities Research (CHAIN), Trondheim
